g.text: Factorio: a game server a friend runs through SFTP only
No shell, no web UI. The operator edits JSON control files; a root timer makes the server match them.
Factorio LXC (unprivileged, on Urd) · one host runs both services
written by the reconciler, read-only for the operator
RCON password: new on every start,
kept outside the SFTP tree and
Sources: docs/services/factorio.md, docs/known-issues/sftpgo-factorio.md. Game and SFTP are the only things exposed to the internet; neither goes through Traefik.
